items.title: Your goal, your split
items.body: Switching goal re-plans your week. Under your goal, pick a split (full body, upper / lower, push pull legs, body part…), tap a day to set its focus, and pick focus muscles for extra sets.

items.title: Bolder switchers
items.body: Explore's Muscles, Categories and Workouts switcher is now colourful tiles with counts. Same look in Community and the workout builder.

items.title: Watch face complications
items.body: Add MonkeyWorkout to any watch face, analog ones too: next workout, weekly goal, streak, week strip, readiness, top lift, last workout. Long-press the face, Edit, then pick MonkeyWorkout.

items.title: Ready the moment you open it
items.body: Readiness, weight and Health data show at launch, no more Connect Apple Health flash. New exercise closes with the X next to Save.

items.title: Choose your session flow
items.body: Pick the blocks of your workouts and drag the time bar to split the minutes. Per workout, for your plan, or in your own workouts. Pin your favourites too, like 7 min treadmill in every warm-up: Session flow → My picks, or long-press an exercise → Always use.
